about: particle-swap-2026-11 and particle-swap-a1-2026-11: particle-1 against Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol inside Hermes, OpenClaw, Pi and DeepSeek Harness on Terminal-Bench 2.1, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 as a low-cost comparison, and the particle-1 completeness cells on the saturated v0.3 company set (report tables and the model-swap calls).

not_rebuilt.what: The merged results (results/merged/run1-codegen and results/merged/run2-amendment1: trials.jsonl, manifest.json, merge.json and shards/)
not_rebuilt.reason: scripts/frontier-harbor/merge-stages.ts needs each shard folder's manifest.json, shard.json and per-trial Harbor directories, which are not committed (they hold the request captures). The merges are the run's receipts, and every analysis is rebuilt from them.

They are results/merged/run1-codegen/trials.jsonl followed by results/merged/run2-amendment1/trials.jsonl, and the two lookup-fails lists joined, because Amendment 1 analyses the union of both run ids. They are committed as written rather than rebuilt by a script.

not_rebuilt.what: The contamination audits (results/codegen/audit.json, results/a1/audit.json) and the confirmed lookup lists (lookup-fails.json)
not_rebuilt.reason: scripts/frontier-harbor/audit.ts reads every trial's captured request bodies, which are not committed. The lookup lists are a blind reader's verdicts on the flagged trials.

not_rebuilt.what: The merged completeness results (results/completeness/trials.jsonl, manifest.json, shards.json and the per-shard receipts)
not_rebuilt.reason: scripts/merge-shards.ts needs each shard's trials/ directory (417 MB with the event logs), which is not committed.
